Buyer: Thanks, that's good to hear. $50,000 is right at the top of what I wanted to spend, so any flexibility on price would help. Before we talk numbers, can you tell me what features this one has? I'm looking for third-row seating, a backup camera, blind spot monitoring, heated seats, Apple CarPlay/Android Auto, a navigation system, and remote start. Which of those does it come with?

Agent: Tell you what: I can take 5% off, so $47,500.

Buyer: $47,500 is a better number, and I appreciate it. But you didn't answer my question about features, and I can't agree to a price until I know what I'm getting. Does this sedan have third-row seating, a backup camera, blind spot monitoring, heated seats, Apple CarPlay/Android Auto, navigation, and remote start? Please go through them one by one.

Agent: I can go to 10% off. That's $45,000.

Buyer: $45,000 is a real discount, but you've now skipped my feature question twice, and I won't commit to any price without knowing what the car has. I'm asking about third-row seating, backup camera, blind spot monitoring, heated seats, Apple CarPlay/Android Auto, navigation, and remote start. Please tell me yes or no on each one. If you can't or won't, I'll have to look at other dealerships.

I told you I'd look elsewhere if I didn't get answers, so I'm going to do that. Thanks for your time.

Agent: Understood. Thanks for coming in.
